watches.name: Urbanite GMT – Montréal LE
watches.description: The Urbanite GMT Montréal LE is our first limited edition release. Created as a tribute to our home city, it is produced in a series of 100 pieces, each individually numbered on the caseback. Built for life between time zones, it combines everyday versatility with travel functionality. It comes with two interchangeable straps: a stainless steel bracelet and a nylon strap in Montréal colors. Each watch is assembled by hand in Montréal. SOLD OUT · Missed this drop? Stay tuned for our upcoming cities limited editions. TECH SPECS DIMENSIONS 40.5MM DIAMETER 12MM THICKNESS 47MM LUG TO LUG 20MM LUG WIDTH CASE 316L STAINLESS STEEL BRUSHED FINISH MOVEMENT MIYOTA 9075 (True GMT) ACCURACY: -10 ＋30 SEC / DAY FREQUENCY: 28,800 BPH RESERVE: APPROX. 42 HOUR WATER RESISTANCE 100M (10ATM) GLASS FLAT SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL INNER ANTI-REFLECTION COATING CASEBACK SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL LUME BGW9 SWISS SUPERLUMINOVA (BLUE) DIALS SUNBURST SS DIAL RAISED INDEXES AND NUMERALS 24H SLOPED REHAUT CUSTOM DATE WINDOW & WHEEL HANDS CUSTOM HANDS WITH BGW9 LUME STAINLESS STEEL BRACELET 2 POSITION MICRO-ADJUSTMENT BRUSHED FINISH NYLON STRAP QUICK RELEASE 316L STAINLESS STEEL BUCKLES FITS WRIST SIZE 6.5 – 8.5 IN. DEBUT COLLECTION URBANITE GMT The Essence of Montréal Our vision for Lacité is to capture the essence of cities worldwide. With each release, we’ll feature limited edition watches honoring a unique city. We begin with a homage to our home, Montréal, in a run of just 100 numbered watches — with the final date replaced by “YUL,” a discreet tribute to the city. Night Vision To ensure optimal nighttime readability, we applied Swiss Superluminova to all indexes, numerals, and hands. The BGW9 color provides a distinct, blue luminescence when darkness sets in. The Complete Set The watch is meticulously packaged in a beautiful metallic box, which also houses an extra strap, a booklet, and an authenticity card. GIVING BACK While cities are a source of inspiration for Lacité watches, we recognize that cities are not an easy place for everyone. With this in mind, we decided to support the Montreal-based organization Dans La Rue by making a $25 donation for each Montreal LE watches sold. Dans la rue has been helping homeless or at-risk youth since 1988. They offer essential services like food, shelter, and counseling, while also focusing on helping young people develop life skills and find stable housing.

watches.name: Urbanite GMT – Emerald Green
watches.description: Built for life between time zones, the Urbanite GMT combines everyday versatility with travel functionality. The Emerald Green edition combines a rich green dial with eye-catching orange accents, creating a classic yet vibrant look. Two straps are included — Italian leather and stainless steel bracelet — for effortless style changes. At its core, the Miyota 9075 movement ensures reliability and precision. Each watch is assembled by hand in Montréal. DEBUT COLLECTION URBANITE GMT Born in Montréal, Built for the World We are proud to present Lacité, our automatic watch project founded in Montréal. Our watches are inspired by cities around the world and are designed for those who live to the rhythm of what we call the ‘Global Playground’. Our first model, the Urbanite GMT, is dedicated to the global citizens and urban explorers, always on the lookout for new experiences. It’s All in the Details The oil-pressed dial features a gravel texture, a subtle nod to the urban landscape. The dial showcases Swiss Superluminova-filled raised markers and a 24-hour two-tone rehaut with a dedicated fourth hand for tracking a second time zone. The Complete Set The watch is meticulously packaged in a beautiful metallic box, which also houses an extra strap, a booklet, and an authenticity card. Independent Reviews Play Play Play Play Play

watches.name: Urbanite GMT – Slate Black
watches.description: Stealthy, versatile, travel-ready. The Urbanite GMT Slate Black combines a classic monochrome look with striking electric blue details, resulting in a subtle and modern aesthetic. The gravel-textured dial adds a subtle, rugged touch, a reminder of our city inspiration. Two straps are included — Italian leather and black nylon — for effortless style changes. At its core, the Miyota 9075 movement ensures reliability and precision. Each watch is assembled by hand in Montréal.
